headline: Found investigations of IA Cases 2026-002 and 2026-003 thorough, timely, objective, and fair.
summary: The meeting approved the September 23, 2026 minutes and discussed draft guidelines for reviewing internal affairs cases, training requirements, and the Community Liaison role. Members found each of four standards met for IA Cases 2026-002 and 2026-003.
decisions: Found the investigation of IA Case 2026-002 was thorough, 6-0.
Found the investigation of IA Case 2026-002 was timely, 6-0.
Found the investigation of IA Case 2026-002 was objective, 6-0.
Found the investigation of IA Case 2026-002 was fair, 6-0.
Found the investigation of IA Case 2026-003 was thorough, 6-0.
Found the investigation of IA Case 2026-003 was timely, 6-0.
Found the investigation of IA Case 2026-003 was objective, 6-0.
Found the investigation of IA Case 2026-003 was fair, 6-0.
